title: Austin's 1990-91 Budget Proposal Unveiled
summary:
*   Austin officials held a special meeting to receive the proposed fiscal budget for the 1990-91 year.
*   City Manager Camille Gate's Barnett presented the detailed budget plan using charts and graphs.
*   Councilmembers reviewed the proposal, engaging in a question-and-answer session with the City Manager.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - August 01, 1990 - 1:00 P.M.
FIRST FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM OF TOWN LAKE CENTER Mayor Cooke called to order the special
called meeting of the Council, noting the presence of all Councilmembers. He announced the
purpose of the meeting vas to receive the 1990-91 proposed budget from the City Manager.
City Manager Camllle Gate's Barnett presented copies of the proposed budget to Council and
departments. After she explained the budgets by use of charts and graphs, the Council
asked several questions.
The meeting was adjourned at 2:40 P.M.
